title: Vignette 2026-10-30: a regular automatic cleanup cycle, dreamtime at a different level

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "Let's clean anything thatvis obviously stale. 
Then test remaining worktrees against their actual repos. 

muDemocracy working groups are now in their own repo. They should not have been committed anyway. 

Let's try to get everything clean. 


This maintenance work is also something we should be managing automatically. It's not quite dreamtime... Although probably the same thing at a different level. We need a regular automatic cleanup cycle. When we see work is stale, we should clean up."
